stories.title: Facade Request/Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define unified request and response schemas for Evaluate Care facade covering clinical trials search and provider detail lookup, including normalization of inputs (condition, location, NPI) and consistent output envelope for cross-domain extensibility.

stories.title: Core Orchestration Logic Across Domain Services
stories.description: Implement facade orchestration logic that routes requests to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, handles sequencing/parallel calls where applicable, and aggregates results into the unified contract.

stories.title: Facade Exposure via Tool Router / API Layer
stories.description: Expose Evaluate Care facade capabilities through the tool_router with validated inputs, allowlisted operations (GOV-004), consistent interface, and standardized error propagation for UI/LLM consumption.

stories.title: Error Handling, Fallbacks, and Partial Response Handling
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling within the facade including upstream API failures, timeouts, and partial data scenarios from clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, ensuring graceful degradation and consistent response structure.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Facade Orchestration
